correctness.rationale: Three exchangeably marked block probabilities follow from the Chinese restaurant process. Counting singleton/pair selections gives the exact first and mixed moments. The product ratio is strictly decreasing in alpha, its endpoint values straddle 1, the consecutive-n ratio has an explicit positive comparison at alpha=2/5 and is increasing in alpha, and gamma ratios plus uniform derivative bounds establish n(1-alpha_n)->2. Exact rational enumeration of all restaurant block-size states at n=3..9 and five rational discounts matches all three moments; numerical root checks through n=1000 corroborate but do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Singleton and doubleton frequencies are basic species-diversity diagnostics. Their covariance changes direction across a unique discount threshold, ruling out uniform positive- or negative-dependence assumptions. Strict monotonicity of the thresholds and the universal 2/n critical window give a motivated finite-to-asymptotic classification and a quantitative boundary between two dependence regimes.
